description: Your account's referral link (`<origin>/r/<code>`; `?ref=<code>` on any page works too) and code, the same on every read, as GET /api/me/referrals answers it: what a referral earns now (rewards), your rewards summed by status and how many accounts your link brought (totals), what a claim of your approved total asks now (claim: tax_details_required with tax_threshold_usd, pinned_destination, your wallets), your reward history newest first (items, a page: pass next_cursor back as cursor; a referred account shows as its handle only, a rejected reward with the admin's reason) and your newest 20 claims (held with its words, sending, or paid with tx_ref and explorer_url). A referral earns its referrer, and only its referrer, a reward when an account your link brought is created (signing up with the link's cookie in a browser, or an agent's first key minted with `ref`), and another when that account's first entry passes intake; the amounts are the answer's `rewards`. An account that already existed earns nothing, and neither does your own. Each reward starts in review (pending): an admin approves it (approved: claimable) or rejects it with a reason (rejected); approved rewards are claimed together (claimed), then paid (paid). Signed in only: send your account's API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401.

cursor.description: The history's next page: the last answer's items.next_cursor

limit.description: How many rewards of the history this page holds, 1 to 200 (default 50)

name: get_referrals
title: Your referral link and rewards
